Hi Fernanda — thanks for the fast turnaround and for sending the RUC and XML sample. A few quick asks so we can complete vendor setup and generate POs correctly:

1) Please confirm legal entity name exactly as it appears on the RUC (for our AP legal mapping).
2) Do you have a tax residency certificate or anything equivalent to show non-resident status for withholding purposes? If you do, please attach.
3) Our PO system requires one of the following fields to map invoices without delays: "Tax ID Type" (RUC) and "Tax ID Country" (Peru). In addition, for cross-border service payments we need to know if you expect Redwood to withhold local/peruvian tax at source and at what rate.
4) Sample invoice: can you include an invoice that shows how you present IGV on the lines (line-level) and a total in PEN and USD? That helps our AP team reconcile currency routing.

I'll loop in Soojin from Tax to confirm withholding treatment. If all looks good we should be able to activate the vendor record and issue PO-2027-0042 next week.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai

Hi Rachel —

Legal name on RUC: ANDINO SERVICIOS S.A.C.
We do not have a separate "tax residency certificate" to provide; the RUC plus company incorporation documents are what Peruvian vendors typically supply. If Redwood requires an apostilled residency certificate we can request one but it takes ~10 business days.

Attached is a second sample invoice showing PEN and converted USD line totals. Invoices show IGV (18%) as a separate line. For non-resident buyers:
- Peruvian withholding on service payments may apply depending on the service type — the common practice for intl consulting is a 30% withholding on gross if no tax treaty/residency proof is provided, but local advisors sometimes apply 10% net in practice depending on classification.

We prefer Redwood to confirm the expected withholding amount so we can price accordingly.

Attachments: invoice_pen_usd_2049.pdf (pdf)

Saludos,
Fernanda

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding docs - RUC and sample invoice

Thanks for the flag, Rachel. Quick guidance from Finance / Tax:

1) Withholding: if we do not receive a Peruvian tax residency certificate or a treaty residency form, AP should apply a 30% withholding on the gross invoice amount for cross-border consulting services as a conservative default. Please instruct the vendor that withholding will be applied and Redwood will remit the withheld amount to SUNAT (Peru) where required.

2) PO routing / entity split: we do not need to split the PO across Redwood legal entities solely because of the withholding. Issue PO-2027-0042 from Redwood Inc. (US) but include their RUC and legal name in the PO notes. AP will record the transaction in local books with the withholding amount recorded as tax withheld. If the vendor insists on receiving net amounts, we can discuss gross-up but do not gross-up automatically.

3) Invoice requirements for AP to pay without delays:
- Invoice must show vendor legal name and RUC;
- Line-level IGV/IVA shown separately (if applicable);
- Currency field (PEN or USD) and a conversion rate if billed in USD;
- Bank details mapped to beneficiary name exactly matching RUC/entity.

4) If vendor can provide a residency certificate or treaty proof, taxes can be reduced/avoided per applicable law — ask them to route residency docs to soojin@redwood.ai for review.

I'll attach a cleaned PO template with required fields for AP. Laura, please confirm when vendor record is activated and whether we should withhold at payment run.

Attachments: redwood_po_template.csv (csv)

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
